failure_history: The first case-lib compile exposed a local string_scope/list concatenation conflict; string_scope was removed without changing the wrapper semantics.
The first C Extern spelling used lowercase string, which the annotation parser did not know.
Declaring lowercase string then exposed QCP's internal String versus Coq string distinction; the Extern argument type was corrected to String while the Rocq definition correctly remains string -> Z.
A second symbolic command on an already-consumed MCP session was discarded because MCP symbolic execution is stateful; two fresh-server runs were then used as the evidence.
